from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import precision_recall_curve
from tensorflow import keras
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

def task_func(X, Y):
    X_arr = np.asarray(X)
    if X_arr.ndim == 1:
        X_arr = X_arr.reshape(-1, 1)
    Y_arr = np.asarray(Y).ravel()

    X_train, X_test, Y_train, Y_test = train_test_split(
        X_arr, Y_arr, test_size=0.3, random_state=42
    )

    input_dim = X_train.shape[1]
    model = keras.Sequential(
        [
            keras.layers.Dense(8, activation="sigmoid", input_shape=(input_dim,)),
            keras.layers.Dense(1, activation="sigmoid"),
        ]
    )
    model.compile(loss="binary_crossentropy", optimizer=keras.optimizers.SGD())
    model.fit(X_train, Y_train, epochs=10, verbose=0)

    y_score = model.predict(X_test, verbose=0).ravel()
    precision, recall, _ = precision_recall_curve(Y_test, y_score)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.plot(recall, precision)
    ax.set_xlabel("Recall")
    ax.set_ylabel("Precision")
    ax.set_title("Precision-Recall Curve")

    return model, ax
